jobs.description:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

Design at Nabla

The Nabla design team works alongside product and engineering to define and deliver high-impact tools that delight clinicians and solve their most pressing pain points.

Our team is responsible for discovering, understanding, and framing user needs, crafting seamless end-to-end experiences, iterating on feedback, and maintaining a scalable internal design system.

 

Our product

Nabla is a medical AI assistant for medical staff, automating their administrative tasks so that they can focus on their patients, not paperwork.

 

What you'll do

  • Thrive in a rapid-iteration environment, shipping high-quality work quickly, and keeping feedback loops tight between design and engineering

  • Lead the end-to-end design process, from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with business goals

  • Meet users during on-sites to gather feedback and test ideas

  • Partner with product managers to discover and validate opportunities with customers, define requirements, and translate research insights into impactful, well-crafted designs

  • Work with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver cohesive, user-centric products

  • Advocate for user needs throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to strategic decision-making at both the product and executive levels

  • Structure, maintain, and evolve Nabla's internal design system, ensuring consistency and scalability in design practices

 

Your DNA

  • 5+ years of experience designing product experiences at a tech or product-driven company

  • A strong portfolio showcasing user-centric solutions that make complex business logic easy to use for the end user

  • Experience designing for both web and mobile, with a strong understanding of responsive behavior and platform constraints

  • Fluency in Figma

  • Curiosity for new design/protoyping tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Paper, etc.)

  • A doer mindset: you’re ready to jump in, iterate fast, and ship

  • Proven ability to communicate design decisions clearly, from concept to implementation, across multidisciplinary teams

  • Solid visual design skills, with a strong sense of craft: you sweat the details and take pride in shipping polished, refined interfaces

 

Where you’ll be based

This position is full-time and based in Paris. or remote france if you’re the profile

Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Le marché du conseil Product & IA vit une accélération rare. Chez Hubvisory, on ne la subit pas : on la pilote, et on cherche la personne qui va porter cette dynamique sur nos comptes les plus stratégiques.

En tant que Business Manager Senior/Lead, tu portes une double responsabilité : faire grandir un portefeuille de grands comptes déjà en place (Dior, Decathlon, Saint-Gobain, Carrefour, Club Med, Leroy Merlin, PMU…) et ouvrir de nouveaux terrains de jeu chez des prospects grands comptes que tu identifies et développes toi-même. Tu n'es pas là pour gérer un existant : tu es là pour le faire croître, et pour en construire un nouveau à côté.

🎯 Tes responsabilités clés

  • Croissance du portefeuille existant : identifier et activer les opportunités d'upsell et de cross-sell, en t'appuyant sur la diversité de nos practices (Product Excellence, Les Agents IA, Transformation & Organisation) pour élargir le périmètre de tes comptes.

  • Chasse de nouveaux comptes : prospecter et qualifier de nouveaux grands comptes, construire et alimenter ta propre pipe, structurer l'entrée en relation jusqu'à la signature.

  • Relation stratégique C-level : devenir l'interlocuteur de confiance de tes clients, comprendre leurs enjeux business en profondeur, sécuriser satisfaction et fidélisation dans la durée.

  • Pilotage commercial rigoureux : piloter ton activité via notre stack (HubSpot pour le CRM, Whoz pour le staffing et le pipe pondéré), suivre ton pipe en régie comme en forfait, et arbitrer ta stratégie de pricing (TJM, marge, positionnement tarifaire) selon le contexte client.

  • Construction et pilotage d'appels d'offres : rédiger des propositions sur-mesure, mener des AO de bout en bout, seul(e) ou avec le soutien du Head of Sales sur les dossiers les plus complexes.

  • Traduction business de l'expertise Product & IA : faire le pont entre l'expertise de nos consultants (Product Managers, AI Engineers, consultants Orga & Transfo) et les enjeux stratégiques de tes clients, y compris sur les usages IA appliqués à la vente elle-même (sales augmenté : préparation de RDV, qualification, veille compte accélérées par l'IA).

⚡ Notre objectif

Faire de toi un Business Manager de référence sur des comptes grands comptes exigeants, avec une trajectoire claire vers des responsabilités élargies (Manager Commercial, pilotage d'un pôle de comptes) selon ton évolution et ton appétence.

💼 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Prestige et diversité des comptes : luxe, retail, banque, secteur public, médias

  • Package évolutif : 60-70K€ + intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits + variable pouvant doubler selon performance

  • Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, hors période d'essai

  • Trajectoire claire : la majorité des postes à responsabilités sont occupés par des collaborateurs ayant évolué en interne

  • Cadre & valeurs : méritocratie réelle, exigence bienveillante, Hubvisory Campus (formation immersive + 1000h de contenu à la carte)

  • Bureaux en plein coeur de Paris (46 Rue Notre-Dame-des-Victoires)

  • Séminaire annuel


🔍 Le profil que nous recherchons

Ce n'est pas ton discours qui fera la différence, mais ta capacité à faire grandir un compte dans la durée et à en ouvrir un nouveau à côté.

  • Expérience obligatoire : 3 ans minimum en vente B2B grands comptes, acquise en cabinet de conseil ou ESN (prestations intellectuelles) — non négociable

  • Grands comptes obligatoire : tu as déjà géré ou développé des comptes de type CAC40/scale-up, pas uniquement des PME

  • Expérience Product souhaitée : une connaissance des enjeux Product Management (Discovery, Delivery, roadmap) est un vrai plus pour dialoguer avec nos clients et nos consultants

  • Compétences clés : cycles de vente complexes multi-interlocuteurs, construction d'offres en régie et au forfait, pilotage d'appels d'offres de bout en bout, lecture d'un pipe pondéré

  • Maturité IA : compréhension des usages IA appliqués à la vente (sales augmenté), capacité à en parler avec crédibilité face à des clients grands comptes

  • Soft skills : culture du résultat, impact relationnel, autonomie et esprit de chasse

📋 Process de recrutement

  1. Préqualification (15 min)

  2. Entretien Talent Acquisition (1h)

  3. Cas pratique avec le Head of Sales (1h30)

  4. Entretien cofondateur (1h)

  5. Offre

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Data Scientist at Predium, you will help develop and improve the data-driven models behind our platform. You will use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods to solve well-defined problems related to buildings, energy performance, and real-estate decarbonization.
Working closely with our engineering and product team, you will turn real-world data into reliable analytical, simulation, and machine-learning models that identify optimization opportunities for more sustainable buildings and help customers make informed investment decisions.


What you'll own

  1. Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain.
  2. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability
  3. Continuously explore and evaluate new data sources to improve model accuracy.
  4. Assess data quality, identify gaps and evaluate model performance by validating assumptions and results against real-world data and feedback of domain experts.
  5. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.


What success looks like

  1. You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions.
  2. Your models and analyses are reproducible, well-documented, and supported by appropriate validation.
  3. You translate technical results into clear implications for the product, our customers, and the business.
  4. You collaborate effectively across Data, Engineering and Product teams.
  5. You actively seek feedback and use it to improve both your technical work and your way of working.


What it takes

  1. A degree in data science, computer science, mathematics or a related field.
  2. 1–2 years of relevant hands-on experience, with programming, ideally in Python, through projects in areas such as physics-based modeling, machine learning, or data pipelines. TypeScript experience for product prototyping is a plus.
  3. A structured, independent approach to problem-solving.
  4. Curiosity about business needs and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  5. Confident communication in English and German.
Bonus:
  1. Initial experience with optimization methods, LLM-based data extraction, or uncertainty and sensitivity analysis.
  2. Familiarity with real estate, building physics, or energy systems.
  3. Experience with tools for physical simulation or energy modeling.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. The models you build feed straight into our product and get used by real customers. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.
30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Network Engineer to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


Contabo Group operates one of Europe's largest cloud infrastructure platforms, with data centres across Europe and beyond. As our new Senior Network Engineer, you take on the network backbone that thousands of customers rely on every day, with real ownership from day one.

Right now, the biggest milestone on your plate is the build out of our new AI data centre. You inherit a fully designed Leaf-Spine architecture built on Arista EOS, BGP EVPN, and VXLAN, take ownership of it, refine it where it needs refining, and drive everything from commissioning through to stable production operations. Alongside that, you keep our existing LTG infrastructure running reliably: you design, build, and operate complex network, server, and security systems, analyse and resolve faults, and harden our network security through scrubbers, firewalls, ACLs, and NAC.

You monitor network traffic and infrastructure performance, extrapolate the KPIs that matter to management, and coordinate with external service providers and remote hands across the globe. You keep our network diagrams, runbooks, change logs, and system documentation in good shape, and you work closely with Platform Engineering on Cilium BGP peering, Kubernetes node network configuration, and IPAM, acting as the ongoing interface between NetOps and Platform.

You join a self-organising, agile team that owns its problems end to end, from analysis to resolution, without micromanagement. On top of that, you will have real room to grow into infrastructure automation, DDoS mitigation with Nokia Deepfield, observability, and BGP EVPN fabric engineering, alongside plenty of national and international project work.

You report directly to our Head of Network and become the permanent owner of everything networking related at Contabo Group, Blue and Black alike. Communication, team orientation, problem solving, and analytical thinking matter just as much here as deep technical expertise, since you will regularly work across teams and explain complex topics to people outside networking.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with complex, scalable networks and fabric infrastructures on Cisco and/or Arista, ideally with real Leaf-Spine and BGP EVPN VXLAN exposure
  • strong expertise in WAN connectivity, data centre peering, uplink management, VPN, and IPv6
  • strong expertise in security administration and DDoS mitigation (e.g. Nokia Deepfield, Aurologic), plus solid monitoring skills with tools like Grafana, Check_MK, or Zabbix
  • good scripting and automation skills with Ansible, Terraform, Python, or similar
  • strong analytical and strategic thinking, paired with clear, confident communication
  • a results-driven, hands-on mindset with a high standard of performance, customer orientation, and composure under pressure
  • genuine team spirit, reliability, and a self-driven way of working that thrives without micromanagement
  • experience with Network Access Control solutions, BGP Flowspec, virtualisation (Proxmox), and IPAM systems such as NetBox
  • strong conflict-handling skills, a knack for building contacts across teams, and openness to change
  • a basic understanding of Kubernetes networking, ideally paired with an Arista certification (or equivalent Cisco knowledge), a completed IT apprenticeship or equivalent, and German language skills alongside excellent English
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at .

jobs.description:

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

What we offer:

jobs.title: Principal Managed Services Consultant
jobs.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.


Job Summary

As a Principal Managed Services Consultant, you will be a key technical authority within our Managed Services organization, combining hands-on client delivery with technical leadership, innovation, and service development. You will report to the Managed Services Manager. 

You will work with strategic enterprise clients, helping them get the most from their Atlassian Cloud environment. This is not a traditional reactive support role: we expect you to anticipate needs, identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing ways of working, and proactively bring new ideas and solutions to our clients.

Alongside client-facing activities, you will help define the technical direction of the Managed Services team, explore emerging Atlassian Cloud capabilities, and turn new technologies and ideas into scalable services that can be deployed across our client portfolio.

The role is preferably based in Germany and/or requires fluency in both German and English, as you will work closely with one of our enterprise clients, for whom German fluency is essential, as well as with our international teams.


What You’ll Be Working On

Deliver Technical Excellence

  • Act as a senior technical expert for complex enterprise Atlassian Cloud environments.

  • Proactively identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve platform stability, scalability, and adoption.

  • Provide hands-on support on complex client needs while driving sustainable, long-term solutions.

    • Shape & Scale Managed Services

    • Help define the technical direction and standards of our Managed Services practice.

    • Identify emerging or underused Atlassian Cloud capabilities and turn them into valuable, repeatable client services.

    • Develop scalable offerings such as health checks, optimization services, and advanced analytics.

      • Drive Innovation

      • Explore how Atlassian Analytics, AI, and automation can improve client experience and Managed Services delivery.

      • Collaborate with international teams to identify and scale successful practices and offerings across regions.

        • Lead Through Expertise

        • Act as a technical reference and mentor for the Managed Services team.

        • Partner with Sales, Delivery, and Transformation Consulting on strategic client engagements and transformation programs.

        • Promote a proactive, consultative mindset focused on continuous client value.


Do You Have What It Takes?

You bring 8–10+ years of experience in technical consulting, application support, platform operations, or similar enterprise technology environments. You have deep expertise in Atlassian Cloud and a strong understanding of the broader Atlassian ecosystem, its architecture, and best practices.

You are comfortable tackling complex technical challenges and looking beyond immediate fixes to design scalable and sustainable solutions. You can assess client environments, identify areas for improvement, and proactively recommend ways to strengthen performance, governance, adoption, and scalability.

You are curious about emerging technologies and keep up with the latest developments across the Atlassian ecosystem, particularly Atlassian Analytics, AI, automation, and Cloud innovation. You are able to turn new capabilities and ideas into practical solutions that create value for clients.

You combine strong ownership and autonomy with a consultative mindset. You can independently lead technical initiatives, understand and challenge client requirements, and engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders in complex enterprise environments.

As a Principal Consultant, you naturally share your expertise and influence technical direction, helping colleagues grow and raising standards across the team. You are comfortable collaborating across functions, teams, and international regions.

Fluency in German and English is mandatory

Why Join Valiantys?

At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

Additional benefits:

  • International and multicultural environment
  • Flexible remote work policy
  • 100% covered health insurance (for you and your family)
  • Choice of equipment (PC or Mac)
  • Supportive and collaborative culture

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Valiantys provides a barrier-free workplace and embraces all qualified applicants with varied perspectives and backgrounds.

jobs.description:
About us

Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel/ LMS Next, companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.


Your mission

As a Working Student (d/f/m) in our Invoicing Team, you will join us at the earliest possible date and support us with reviewing carrier invoices, contributing to efficient and reliable billing processes. You will be part of an international team of seven colleagues, based across Hamburg, Naarden, Nantes, and Madrid.

You can look forward to a working environment where mutual support, team spirit, and positive collaboration are at the heart of how we work.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for reviewing and checking carrier invoices across different brands and countries.

  • You handle related invoice claims and clarify any discrepancies.

  • You review carrier rates and ensure they are correctly reflected in the invoice checks.

  • You gather the information required for invoice checks from relevant stakeholders and coordinate with them.

  • As part of the invoice checking process for LMS Next, you also support the posting of carrier invoices.

  • You support the testing of improvements to the invoice checking process before they are implemented.

  • You support the implementation of our new accounting system, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.


What you need to succeed

jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.
  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.
  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.
  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

OPENING FROM KRAKEN TECHNOLOGIES FRANCE 🇫🇷 - ALL LOCATIONS

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our mission is to provide cheaper, greener energy to the French market.

 

Octopus Energy France is a fast-growing energy company recognized as an ESS (social economy). **We offer a better experience to our customers through transparency, honesty and simplicity. We want to do better for the planet, through real, long-term investment in renewable energy production and a low-CO2 future that's better for our customers' wallets. We want to revolutionize the energy business through our people, our platform and our use of data.

 

Our focus is on customer satisfaction, and receiving positive reviews is important to us - we have the best score among French energy suppliers on Google Reviews and Trust Pilot.

 

Kraken technologies

 

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. Current clients are both the Octopus Energy retails businesses around the world as well as external clients such as Good Energy, Origin, EDF, E.ON & Queensland Energy - with many more expected to join over the next few years!

 

Our team

 

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 450 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

 

Our technology

 

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and the Django-REST-framework. We also use Pandas, Numpy and Jupyter for analysis and forecasting, plus Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS and Airflow for background processing.

 

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

 

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

  • You will be working in a multi-disciplinary software engineering team; solving design challenges; domain modeling; solving technical problems; engineering solutions for smart meters, writing robust fault-tolerant software primarily in Python and Django, Celery, and async processing

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The energy market is complicated, outdated, and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modeling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

The energy landscape is changing as we move to more disaggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism, and smarter technology. Octopus Energy was the first UK supplier to introduce a "tracker" tariff whose prices track the daily wholesale prices: http://www.cleanenergynews.co.uk/news/efficiency/octopus-offerstransparency-with-wholesale-price-tariff

  • You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our parent company is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK and is funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the world towards a lower carbon future.

jobs.description:
About Singulier

Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact.

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution.

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where consultants are expected to think critically, take ownership early, work directly with senior stakeholders and contribute to building long-term client impact.

The role

As an Engagement Manager - Business & AI Transformation, you will lead complex transformation engagements for clients facing critical strategic, operational and organisational challenges.

You will combine strategic thinking, product expertise and hands-on execution to translate business needs into high-impact transformation initiatives. Working at the intersection of business, product, technology, data and AI, you will help clients transform functions, teams, operating models and ways of working while ensuring that solutions create measurable and sustainable value.

You will lead taskforces composed of strategy consultants and senior digital experts located across France and the UK, with the support of a Principal or Partner.

What you will do ?

Lead transformation engagements

  • Lead business, product, technology, data and AI transformation programmes from initial framing through execution and closing.
  • Structure the problem, define the overall approach and organise the engagement into clear workstreams.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives and concrete delivery plans.
  • Combine strategic analysis, product thinking and operational execution to accelerate impact.
  • Support the identification, prototyping, prioritisation and deployment of high-value solutions where relevant.
  • Drive problem-solving and analyses while maintaining a high level of quality and strategic coherence.
  • Ensure that transformation initiatives deliver tangible business outcomes and sustainable improvements in performance.

Lead clients and stakeholders

  • Manage the day-to-day client relationship with senior and C-level stakeholders.
  • Facilitate workshops, decision-making sessions and alignment discussions across business, product and technology teams.
  • Translate between business priorities, operational requirements and technical possibilities.
  • Handle complex queries and challenges with confidence and pragmatism.
  • Navigate complex, political and multi-stakeholder environments successfully.
  • Build trust with clients by combining strategic perspective, delivery discipline and a strong focus on outcomes.

Own project delivery

  • Lead projects from execution to closing, ensuring that timelines, milestones and team responsibilities remain on track.
  • Manage resources, team capacity and end-products while contributing to project profitability.
  • Participate in setting up the appropriate team of strategy consultants and digital experts.
  • Ensure the quality, consistency and executive-readiness of all key deliverables.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment with the client and the Singulier leadership team.
  • Ensure the appropriate capitalisation of project knowledge, methodologies and reusable assets.

Contribute to business development

  • Contribute to building proposals and responding to client opportunities with the support of Partners, Principals, Directors and practice leaders.
  • Help shape the problem statement, transformation approach, workplan, team structure and commercial scope.
  • Identify opportunities to extend client relationships and support the growth of Singulier’s transformation offering.
  • Bring innovative ideas to proposals, client presentations and problem-solving discussions.
  • Contribute to the development of Singulier’s market positioning and thought leadership on business, product, technology, data and AI transformation.

Develop people and build the firm

  • Lead and develop teams of consultants and digital experts across engagements.
  • Coach Consultants, Analysts and junior team members, helping them build both consulting and transformation capabilities.
  • Provide clear direction, feedback and support throughout projects.
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, methodology development, knowledge sharing and recruitment.
  • Help strengthen the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of Singulier.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • 4–5+ years of experience in a strategy, digital, product, technology or business transformation consulting firm.
  • Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes in environments involving multiple stakeholders.
  • The ability to combine strategic vision, structured problem-solving and operational execution.
  • Experience working across business, product, technology, data or AI topics.
  • A strong understanding of how technology, data and AI can transform business functions, operating models and ways of working.
  • Experience translating business needs into transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives or actionable delivery plans.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, resources and deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with confidence operating at senior and C-level.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly.
  • Demonstrated commercial abilities and an interest in contributing to proposals and business development.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with the autonomy, pragmatism and proactivity required to thrive in a fast-growing environment.
  • Fluency in both French and English is required.

Benefits

Why join Singulier?

  • Work at the intersection of strategy, business transformation, product, technology, data and AI.
  • Lead high-impact engagements with senior executives, investors and ambitious businesses.
  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and tangible client outcomes.
  • Work in international taskforces alongside experienced consultants and digital experts.
  • Benefit from significant autonomy, exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a fast-scaling consulting platform.

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

Discover more about METYCLE:

About us | LinkedIn

Bumble is looking for a Director, International Core Markets, Integrated Marketing to lead the strategy and performance of our portfolio of established international markets.

Reporting to the VP of International Markets, you will be responsible for defining what it takes for Bumble to win across our Core Markets, protecting and strengthening our market position while identifying the next opportunities for sustainable growth, cultural relevance, and brand leadership.This is a senior leadership and people management role. You will lead and develop a team of market leaders, setting clear strategic direction while empowering them to translate Bumble's global strategy into locally relevant, insight-led market plans.

You are a strategic and empathetic leader who sets a high bar for both thinking and execution. You know how to coach teams, navigate complexity, challenge established approaches, make difficult prioritization decisions, and create an environment where people have the clarity, autonomy, and support to do their best work.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the strategy and performance of Bumble's International Core Markets portfolio, establishing a clear long term vision, drives sustainable growth, and remains culturally relevant in each market.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of market leaders, setting clear direction and empowering them to own outcomes.

  • Drive alignment across the portfolio, ensuring teams stay focused on priorities, share learnings, and adapt quickly as business needs evolve.

  • Regularly assess performance across the portfolio and make deliberate choices about where to prioritize, where to invest, where to optimize.

  • Establish clear success measures across the portfolio and champion a strong culture of measurement and learning.

  • Use performance and consumer insights to continuously challenge assumptions and evolve market strategies.

  • Build strong partnerships with Global Marketing, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Partnerships, Research & Insights and other cross-functional teams, ensuring Core Market priorities are clearly represented and incorporated into broader company plans.

  • Communicate portfolio performance, priorities, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership, translating complexity into clear recommendations and decisions.

  • Build a high performing and inclusive team culture grounded in trust, accountability, openness, and mutual respect.

  • Act as a senior leader within the broader International organization, contributing beyond the Core Markets portfolio by sharing frameworks, market learnings, leadership practices, and strategic perspectives that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

 

KEY SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA or Master's is a plus

  • +12 years of experience in brand, integrated, or strategic marketing, ideally in consumer tech, lifestyle, or culturally-driven brands.

  • Significant experience in senior brand, integrated, strategic, or market marketing leadership roles, ideally within consumer technology, lifestyle, entertainment, or other culturally driven brands.

  • Proven experience leading multiple markets, business units, or a complex portfolio, with accountability for setting strategy, determining priorities, and driving measurable business and brand outcomes.

  • Strong people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach and develop high performing teams and managers.

  • Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to move between the portfolio level view and individual market dynamics and determine what matters most.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex market challenges by synthesizing information and translating those insights into clear strategic choices.

  • Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with experience using data, measurement, and ROI frameworks to inform prioritization, investment decisions, and changes in strategy.

  • Deep understanding of integrated marketing and the role of brand, media, creators, partnerships, communications, experiential, product marketing, and growth in driving both brand and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of international marketing and the balance between global consistency and meaningful local relevance.

  • Proven ability to influence and align senior cross functional stakeholders.

  • Excellent executive communication skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast moving environment.

  • Excellent relationship building, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

 

ABOUT YOU

  • You are a portfolio strategist. You can look across multiple markets, identify the few challenges and opportunities that matter most, and translate them into a clear direction for the organization.

  • You are a leader of leaders. You create clarity and set a high bar.

  • You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and dive in when necessary..

  • You are deeply consumer and culture focused but equally comfortable with business performance and data.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and can create structure and direction without waiting for every answer to be available.

  • You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across functions.

  • You are energized by change and know how to lead others through it with clarity, transparency, resilience, and optimism.

  • You think beyond established playbooks. You are willing to test new approaches and encourage your teams to do the same when existing solutions are no longer sufficient.

  • You are an excellent communicator who can turn complexity into a clear story.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
  • Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
  • Help build out DoorDash's international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.
  • Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.

We're excited about you because…

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.
  • You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.
  • You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.

  • You're comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don't need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.
  • You're an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.
  • You're comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).
  • You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.
  • You're an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Partner closely with business stakeholders with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Learn something new everyday Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Contrat : CDI

L'entreprise

Pysae est un éditeur de logiciels de 40 personnes qui développe des solutions SaaS pour le secteur du transport public. Notre plateforme couvre le suivi des véhicules en temps réel, l'information voyageurs et la gestion des opérations pour les opérateurs de bus et d'autocars — conçue pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et s'intégrer en profondeur aux systèmes d'information de nos clients.

Nous accompagnons plus de 120 clients, dont de grands opérateurs comme Transdev, Keolis et RATP, et équipons plus de 10 000 bus en France métropolitaine, en Italie, en Belgique, en Suisse et en Arabie saoudite. Fort de notre ancrage en France, nous poursuivons aujourd'hui notre développement à l'international — et nous recherchons un(e) Bid Engineer pour renforcer notre gestion des appels d'offres et notre capacité d'avant-vente, avec un focus sur notre expansion européenne.

Votre mission

En tant que Bid Engineer, vous êtes la clé de voûte de la conquête commerciale de Pysae sur les appels d'offres — et une voix technique de référence auprès des clients en phase d'avant-vente. Vous alliez de solides qualités rédactionnelles et analytiques à la capacité de présenter clairement notre solution à un DSI, un directeur d'exploitation ou une direction des achats.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec les équipes Sales, Produit et Déploiement pour évaluer nos engagements possibles et construire une réponse convaincante et conforme à chaque consultation. Vous êtes également le lien entre toutes les parties lorsque Pysae candidate en tant qu'intégrateur : vous coordonnez partenaires, sous-traitants et maîtres d'œuvre externes pour que chacun livre sa contribution dans les délais. Du premier appel d'offres à la signature du contrat, vous faites en sorte que Pysae se présente de façon crédible, rigoureuse et prête à délivrer.

Vos responsabilités

Gestion des appels d'offres

  • Assurer la veille et la qualification des appels d'offres pertinents pour Pysae, en France et à l'international

  • Analyser les cahiers des charges et évaluer la faisabilité technique et commerciale avec les équipes Sales, Produit et Déploiement

  • Rédiger et structurer les mémoires techniques et les réponses aux consultations, en adaptant et traduisant les dossiers pour le marché européen

  • Garantir la conformité administrative des dépôts (pièces justificatives, attestations, délais, plateformes de dématérialisation)

Avant-vente et relation client

  • Présenter Pysae et la solution aux clients et prospects lors des rendez-vous d'avant-vente : démonstrations produit, prérequis techniques, questions fonctionnelles et techniques

  • Accompagner l'équipe commerciale sur les sujets techniques, de la découverte du besoin jusqu'au closing

Coordination partenaires et projets
